rows.name: Oklahoma State Board of Medical Licensure and Supervision
rows.mandate: Licenses and disciplines Oklahoma's physicians. Eleven members appointed by the Governor — physicians and public members (59 O.S. Sec. 481).
rows.criticalNote: Curated from the Oklahoma Statutes; OK publishes no central board-vacancy list (inventory mode)

rows.name: Oklahoma Board of Nursing
rows.mandate: Licenses and regulates Oklahoma's nurses. Eleven members appointed by the Governor — six registered nurses, three licensed practical nurses, and two public members (59 O.S. Sec. 567.4).
rows.criticalNote: Curated from the Oklahoma Statutes; OK publishes no central board-vacancy list (inventory mode)

rows.name: Oklahoma Wildlife Conservation Commission
rows.mandate: Governs the Oklahoma Department of Wildlife Conservation — hunting, fishing, and wildlife policy. Eight members appointed by the Governor and confirmed by the Senate to eight-year terms (Okla. Const. Art. XXVI).
rows.criticalNote: Curated from the Oklahoma Constitution; OK publishes no central board-vacancy list (inventory mode)

rows.name: Oklahoma Real Estate Commission
rows.mandate: Licenses and regulates Oklahoma's real estate brokers. Seven members appointed by the Governor with Senate consent — five brokers, a lay person, and a real-estate educator (59 O.S. Sec. 858-201).
rows.criticalNote: Curated from the Oklahoma Statutes; OK publishes no central board-vacancy list (inventory mode)

rows.name: Oklahoma State Board of Pharmacy
rows.constituent: Oklahoma patients & licensed pharmacists · drug safety
rows.mandate: Licenses pharmacists and regulates pharmacy practice in Oklahoma. Six members appointed by the Governor — five licensed pharmacists and one public member (59 O.S. Sec. 353.3).
rows.criticalNote: Curated from the Oklahoma Statutes; OK publishes no central board-vacancy list (inventory mode)
